items.title: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
items.summary: A new AI lab named Prentis, co-founded by prominent tech figures Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus, is reportedly seeking to raise $100 million, signaling significant investment in the AI research and development space.

items.title: Anthropic launches Cowork, a Claude Desktop agent that works in your files — no coding required
items.summary: Anthropic has introduced 'Cowork,' a new Claude desktop agent designed to interact directly with user files without requiring any coding, aiming to make advanced AI assistance more accessible for everyday tasks.

items.title: Introducing OpenAI Presence
items.summary: OpenAI has officially launched 'OpenAI Presence,' a new initiative or product that is expected to expand their AI capabilities or reach, though specific details are yet to be fully disclosed.

items.title: Nous Research's NousCoder-14B is an open-source coding model landing right in the Claude Code moment
items.summary: Nous Research has released NousCoder-14B, an open-source coding model that directly competes with commercial offerings like Claude Code, providing a free alternative for developers.

items.title: Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage
items.summary: Cognition's acquisition of Poke highlights a growing industry trend where developing distinct AI personalities is seen as a crucial competitive differentiator.

items.title: I tried out OpenAI’s new AI keypad — which will be fun for some coders and slightly mystifying to everyone else
items.summary: A review of OpenAI's new AI keypad suggests it offers a novel and potentially useful interface for coders, while its appeal to a broader audience remains uncertain.

items.title: ReferTrack: Referring Then Tracking for Embodied Visual Tracking
items.summary: Researchers introduce ReferTrack, a new method for embodied visual tracking that first refers to an object and then tracks it, achieving high engagement in the research community.

items.title: Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation
items.summary: A new research paper explores Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation, a technique for improving model efficiency and performance through self-supervised learning.

items.title: Open Weights and American AI Leadership
items.summary: A discussion from Microsoft's corporate responsibility blog explores the strategic importance of open-weight AI models for maintaining American leadership in artificial intelligence.

items.title: Anthropic's Claude Code costs up to $200 a month. Goose does the same thing for free.
items.summary: This article highlights a significant cost disparity between Anthropic's Claude Code, priced at up to $200/month, and a free alternative named Goose that offers similar functionalities.

items.title: 3 Google updates from Galaxy Unpacked 2026
items.summary: Google announced three new updates at Galaxy Unpacked 2026, likely integrating advanced AI features into Android and Samsung devices to enhance user experience.

items.title: Unlocking Britain’s next era of productivity: Building a nation of AI trailblazers
items.summary: Google's blog post outlines strategies for the UK to leverage AI to boost national productivity and foster a new generation of AI innovators.

items.title: How news organizations are using AI to advance their vital missions
items.summary: OpenAI's blog details various ways news organizations are adopting AI technologies to enhance their operations and fulfill their core journalistic objectives.

items.title: Advancing the next era of national science
items.summary: OpenAI discusses its commitment to advancing scientific research at a national level, likely through collaborations and access to its cutting-edge AI technologies.

items.title: Show, Don't Tell: Evaluating Spatial Cognition in Generative Pixels Rather Than LLM Text
items.summary: New research proposes evaluating spatial cognition in AI by analyzing generative pixels instead of relying solely on LLM text outputs, offering a more direct assessment method.
